title: Long in darkness, now two torches
odia:
କାଳକ ଗଲା ଅନ୍ଧାର ଘର
ଲାଗିଚି ଏବେ ଯୋଡି ମଶାଲ।
literal_meaning: So much time passed with the house dark; now a pair of torches is lit.
meaning_odia: ଦୀର୍ଘ ସମୟ ଧରି ଅଭାବ ଥିବା ଜାଗାରେ ଏବେ ବେଶି ଆୟୋଜନ ହୋଇଥିବାର ବିପରୀତ ଚିତ୍ର। ଆଗର ଅନ୍ଧାର ଘର ଓ ଏବର ଯୋଡ଼ି ମଶାଲକୁ ଏକାଠି ରଖି ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନଟିକୁ ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The saying places a long period without light beside the arrival of two torches. Its explicit contrast is between earlier lack and present abundance. This edition reads it as a pointed observation on how conspicuously circumstances have changed.
usage_example: A meeting room goes without basic equipment for years, then receives an elaborate new setup. Someone recalls the contrast between the dark house and its two torches. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The house stays the same while its illumination changes. A pair of torches makes the new provision stand out against the earlier darkness, and ଏବେ marks the turn from then to now.
